scripts.build: npm run build -w @designflow/shared && npm run build -w @designflow/generator && npm run build -w @designflow/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @designflow/shared && tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck:browser -w @designflow/shared && npm run typecheck -w @designflow/generator
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @designflow/shared && tsx watch --env-file=.env apps/api/src/server.ts
scripts.test:unit: npm run build -w @designflow/shared && vitest run packages/shared/tests packages/generator/tests apps/api/tests/estimate-service.test.ts apps/api/tests/foundation.test.ts apps/api/tests/supabase-adapter.test.ts
scripts.test:generator: npm run build -w @designflow/shared && vitest run packages/generator/tests
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @designflow/shared && vitest run apps/api/tests/backend.integration.test.ts supabase/tests/database.test.ts
scripts.test:supabase: npm run build -w @designflow/shared && vitest run --config vitest.supabase.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
